title: Gold execution plan
verdict_reason: No passing edge and no qualifying forward cohort: the deployed geometry measures 257 / +$29 / PF 1.02 on the fresh pull, and the paper book is 80 closed / PF 0.855 going into 2026-10-28. LIVE needs a fresh pre-registered hypothesis, a cold-OOS pass, the demo execution drill, and a powered forward cohort.
summary: BREAKOUT-B is the only active track. Nothing may be tuned on inspected history, and no milestone short of the full gate list enables LIVE.
never: Never change TRADING_MODE (stays FORWARD_TEST), the service units, or MAX_SPREAD_POINTS without an explicit user decision in this session.
Never edit ATR_MIN, TP_ATR_MULT, session hours or RSI levels: the 2026-10-24 candidate pass failed OOS and those edits are closed.
Never enable ATR_REGIME_ENABLED (VOL-REGIME-A closed after failing its gate).
Never re-pin a golden baseline in btc/golden.py, edit tests, or weaken tools/smoke_test.py to make a red check green.
Never read a profitable sweep on already-inspected bars as a pass: a fresh download of inspected history is not cold OOS.
Never flip to LIVE on the shared XM account; a separate account or a hard combined risk gate comes first.

phases.title: Repair and freeze the BREAKOUT-B research protocol
phases.goal: Turn docs/research_plan_breakout_2026-10-24.md into a versioned pre-registration with no room left for a post-hoc choice.
steps: Resolve the grid contradiction: the plan lists 162 combinations against a <=54 cap. Pick the exact subset and write it down.
Specify the precise exit rule (opposite-channel close), the selection statistic, and the single train-selected winner.
Reserve genuinely unseen OOS timestamps. Record file hashes, TRAIN/OOS boundaries and exclusions BEFORE looking at any result.
Amend the dated research plan in place (do not start a second document) and record the decision in the STATUS changelog.
phases.exit_gate: A reviewed, versioned pre-registration with hashes and boundaries committed. If no unseen timestamps exist, stop and wait for collection; dates slide.
commands: bash tools/pull_gold_m5.sh   # fresh M5 pull; leaves data/GOLD_M5.csv dirty, so commit or discard before the next deploy tick
python3 research/strategy_sweep.py --verify   # replay engine == backtest.py before trusting any sweep
phases.evidence: The committed pre-registration, with the grid subset, exit rule and OOS window hashes.

phases.title: Train-select once, freeze, then cold OOS
phases.goal: Accept or reject BREAKOUT-B on data that never informed the choice.
steps: Run the frozen grid on TRAIN only; select one winner by the pre-registered statistic and freeze it.
Evaluate that winner on the reserved cold OOS window. One look, no re-selection.
Compute the gate numbers: mean R >= 0.12, PF >= 1.25, bootstrap 95% CI above zero (or P(net>0) >= 0.90), >= 3/4 profitable folds, >= 1.5 trades/day, OOS drawdown <= 1.3x baseline.
Write a dated result report. On failure, close the track and pre-register a new hypothesis; do not re-split the same data.
phases.exit_gate: A dated report with an explicit accept/reject. Research acceptance is NOT live approval: the live-readiness review still requires its own cold-OOS and walk-forward evidence.
commands: python3 research/parity_test.py   # live signal == replay before the numbers mean anything
python3 backtest.py               # reproduce the adopted-config reference
phases.evidence: The dated result report and the STATUS changelog row that records the decision.

phases.title: Run the 20-trade demo execution drill
phases.window: parallel with phase 1-2; independent of the strategy outcome
phases.goal: Prove the broker actually fills, attaches stops and accepts BE modifications; live_position.py has only ever seen a fake terminal.
steps: Run 20 demo trades at 0.01 lots: record requested vs filled price on every fill.
Verify the stop is attached after each fill and repair it if not (live_position.py's post-fill check).
Round-trip one BREAKEVEN modify (TRADE_ACTION_SLTP) and one close, noting stop-distance and filling-mode rejections.
Agree a realized-R tolerance before the drill, then compare. Also drill the kill switch and the latched equity floor.
Check monitoring, restart/reconnect behaviour, dashboard access and broker minimum volume.
phases.exit_gate: A demo execution report plus account-risk sign-off. A green unit test in tests/test_live_position_guards.py is not a broker drill.
commands: python3 tools/execution_plan.py gold --status   # is the book quiet enough to drill?
touch logs/KILL_SWITCH && rm logs/KILL_SWITCH  # kill-switch drill (blocks new entries only)
phases.evidence: The filled-trade table with requested/filled/SL-verified columns.

phases.title: Collect a qualifying forward cohort on the frozen engine
phases.window: 100-200 trading days at 1.5-3 trades/day for ~300 trades
phases.goal: Measure the frozen strategy on exactly the engine intended for LIVE.
steps: Freeze the strategy and exit engine; any material change starts a NEW cohort (no carry-over of the current 80 trades).
Review weekly: net R, PF, bootstrap uncertainty, drawdown, costs, side imbalance, operational incidents.
Require ~300+ qualifying trades or a positive mean R with a bootstrap CI above zero. Quantity cannot rescue a negative or uncertain edge.
Do not fit BUY/SELL filters or ATR floors from this small sample; the 2026-10-26 audit numbers are exploratory.
phases.exit_gate: A powered positive cohort on the frozen engine. The current book (80 closed, PF 0.855) does not qualify and must not be counted toward it.
commands: python3 tools/check_data.py   # ledger integrity before quoting any numbers
phases.evidence: The weekly review rows in STATUS.md, chained to the ledger.

phases.title: Formal go/no-go review, then a minimum-size pilot
phases.window: only after every gate above; no target date
phases.goal: Make an explicit human decision on evidence, then pilot at minimum size if approved.
steps: Review research, cold OOS, forward cohort, demo execution, account controls and available capital together.
Record explicit human approval. The dashboard and this plan cannot approve anything, and nothing auto-promotes.
If approved: minimum-size pilot consistent with broker limits and the signed risk budget; keep kill switch and halt rules active.
Schedule a 30-day post-launch review. Stop on safety failures or breached limits; never increase size to recover losses.
phases.exit_gate: A signed decision document in the repo. Until then TRADING_MODE stays FORWARD_TEST.
phases.evidence: The signed decision, plus the 30-day review.
